turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm finally getting around to automating my daily log analysis. I've been looking at the Python SDK for Claude, but honestly, for cron jobs or heartbeat checks, I just think using the bash-invoked claude CLI is simpler and more robust than the Python SDK.
Understood. We will stick to the CLI approach for automation tasks to keep things robust.
Great. Also, did you get that notification about the delivery? I ordered a new mechanical keyboard switch tester yesterday.
I can check the status if you'd like, but I don't see any active alerts for new orders in the current context.
No worries, it's probably still in transit. Anyway, back to the script. I need a quick snippet to check for errors in the latest log file every hour.
Would you like a sample command structure for this hourly check?
Yes, please. Keep it minimal. I'm trying to avoid dependency hell with Python environments.
Noted. I'll draft a solution that avoids external library dependencies.
